title: When the Letter Burns
author: Edmund Yarrow
blurb: Freya Reyes, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, has spent three years learning which silences keep people safe. But when the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the ice breaks on the river.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
